value.text:
The sources make mining four separate claims: rocks break, they drop crystals, crystals are picked up, and the hold has a ceiling past which they are simply lost. The size trade-off is a fifth and is the only decision in the loop.
usecase UC-E2-1 "Pilot breaks an asteroid apart" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-1 asteroid
ground UC-E2-1 weapons
requires UC-E2-1 S:in_field
establishes UC-E2-1 S:rock_broken
includes E2 UC-E2-1
state S:rock_broken "an asteroid has been broken"
accept UC-E2-1 "an asteroid takes damage from weapons fire and breaks"
usecase UC-E2-2 "A broken asteroid leaves crystals in the field" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-2 gem
ground UC-E2-2 asteroid
requires UC-E2-2 S:rock_broken
establishes UC-E2-2 S:gems_loose
includes E2 UC-E2-2
state S:gems_loose "crystals are loose in the field"
accept UC-E2-2 "a broken asteroid leaves crystals where it was"
accept UC-E2-2 "a larger asteroid leaves larger chunks than a smaller one"
usecase UC-E2-3 "Pilot picks up a loose crystal" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-3 gem
requires UC-E2-3 S:gems_loose
establishes UC-E2-3 S:gems_held
includes E2 UC-E2-3
state S:gems_held "crystals are in the ship's hold"
accept UC-E2-3 "flying over a loose crystal puts it in the hold"
usecase UC-E2-4 "The hold refuses crystals past its ceiling" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-4 "cargo capacity"
requires UC-E2-4 S:gems_held
establishes UC-E2-4 S:hold_bounded
includes E2 UC-E2-4
state S:hold_bounded "the hold has a known ceiling and enforces it"
accept UC-E2-4 "a pickup that would exceed the ceiling is lost rather than held"
accept UC-E2-4 "a full hold accepts nothing until something leaves it"
because UC-E2-4 "a ceiling is what makes returning to spend a decision rather than a formality"
instead UC-E2-4 "an unbounded hold, which would remove the reason ever to stop mining"
usecase UC-E2-5 "Pilot chooses between big rocks and safe ones" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-5 asteroid
requires UC-E2-5 S:hold_bounded
establishes UC-E2-5 S:mining_has_a_cost
includes E2 UC-E2-5
state S:mining_has_a_cost "the pilot is trading safety for yield"
accept UC-E2-5 "a larger asteroid yields more crystals per unit of damage dealt"
accept UC-E2-5 "a larger asteroid takes longer, leaving the pilot in one place for longer"
because UC-E2-5 "without the size trade-off mining is a chore rather than a choice"
instead UC-E2-5 "every asteroid worth the same, which the sources contradict"
usecase UC-E2-6 "The hold fills" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-6 "cargo capacity"
ground UC-E2-6 "upgrade cost"
requires UC-E2-6 S:mining_has_a_cost
establishes UC-E2-6 S:cargo_full
includes E2 UC-E2-6
accept UC-E2-6 "the hold reports itself full at the documented capacity for the tier"
accept UC-E2-6 "a full hold is what unlocks both the extra life and the next ship"
